# Feats #355 fixtures

Exactly 100 ordered pf1-content Feat candidates from [#355](https://github.com/AndreasUnunger/EverythingPath/issues/355), at 11.4.0 (`02f4ab0d`). System dependencies use v11.11 (`418761d2`). Original source bytes, complete descriptions, supporting-rule identities, PCGen comparison bytes and the pinned publication bibliography are retained. Empty manifest packs have `.gitkeep`.

`preview.json` retains all selected definitions from the complete source import. `binding-preview.json` and `provenance.json` identify the complete-source reference closure and its raw byte witnesses. The reduced raw lookup namespace is not claimed to reproduce every complete-source prerequisite; those complete facts are transported explicitly. Supporting bodies remain separately identified as governing or prerequisite audit evidence. Neither a generic class header nor a same-name racial/class record establishes a complete governing rule.

Skill Focus (Climb) is admitted with the ordinary CRB +3/+6 benefit, exclusive manually selected rank Situations, stable identity and nonstacking copies. The raw rank formula remains unsupported. All other candidates retain whole-content holds; non-CRB notice-chain holds are enforced. No held body is offered by the isolated release.

The public resolver and isolated Convex tests exercise the same admitted body, mixed copies, another skill, inactive selections, campaign access, saved-sheet previews, catalog reads, release transport and public legal reads. Character-scoped held-body examples do not change global admission.

`original-identities.json` freezes every earlier fixture/owning inventory and raw shared value at the supplied base. `protected-context.json` freezes the historical complete-context union, including held dependencies. `verification.json` reports the fresh source-only proof and explicitly pending local bindings; `local-binding-proof.json` independently covers the 34 local conditions. `historical-binding-proof.json` combines these scopes. These are historical receipts, not results rerun every time a test reads them.

The batch report is [feats-355.md](../../../docs/catalog-import/feats-355.md). No deployment or production activation occurs in these fixtures.
